title: Large firms behind certified local firms, in the other screens
question: Are the big companies recorded as affiliates of certified local firms the same ones that show bid, change-order, donor or lobbying patterns?
finding: 52 of 74 large firms tied to a certified local firm (recorded affiliate, same team or same address) turn up in other screens; 24 of them in a lobbying, donor, commissioner or permit-speed screen. Most often: HELUNA HEALTH (affiliate of Immaculate Concepts International LLC), in 12 groups: aliases: One owner, several names, all paid by the City; autopilot: Still paid after the term ran out; chains: Hired after a contract and 3 more.
how: Pairs from three lbe_fronts screens (restricted affiliates paid, larger firm beside a certified firm, affiliate on the same team) were looked up by the larger firm's normalised name in every published row of the older screens. "Influence" lists the groups among lobbyists, sidedoors, officials, fastlane, chains, leaks, statemoney and permit_metrics.
limits: The City records these affiliations itself; a big affiliate does not make the certified firm ineligible, and what matters is whether the certified firm's share was credited toward a goal on a contract the affiliate bid. A large contractor is expected to appear in many screens because it holds many contracts. Name matches only; only published rows are searched.
